Name: Sibbechai the Hushathite
Summary: Hushathite who slew Sippai of the children of the giant at Gezer.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 20:4: Hushathite who slew Sippai of the children of the giant at Gezer.
LifeLesson: The mention of Sibbechai in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
